JOURNEY: The steward's ward flickers: recover the three seals before ash takes the vault.
征途日志: 管事的护佑正在消退。必须找回三枚封印，阻止灰烬吞噬密库。

JOURNEY: The first guards fall. A sealed cache hums beneath the outer reliquary.
征途日志: 外围卫兵倒下了。圣匣深处传来封印宝箱的低鸣。

JOURNEY: A reliquary seal locks into the blade. Malrec's gate weakens.
征途日志: 第一枚封印融入遗物之刃，马尔雷克的大门开始松动。

JOURNEY: The inner sanctum opens, and acolytes answer the broken seal.
征途日志: 内殿的大门敞开，侍僧从破碎封印后涌出。

JOURNEY: Seal Warden Vhal falls. The second reliquary seal answers the blade.
征途日志: 封印守卫瓦尔倒下了，第二枚封印回应着你的剑。

JOURNEY: The final seal burns inside the ember altar. Extinguish it before the keeper wakes.
征途日志: 最后一枚封印在余烬祭坛中燃烧。趁守护者苏醒前熄灭祭坛。

JOURNEY: Malrec rises from the ash gate: your relic blade is the last binding oath.
征途日志: 马尔雷克从灰烬之门中崛起，遗物之刃是束缚他的最后誓约。

JOURNEY: Malrec staggers, but the reliquary shakes with borrowed fire.
征途日志: 马尔雷克踉跄后退，窃来的火焰仍在震撼圣匣。

JOURNEY: The ash oath breaks. The reliquary is yours, for now.
征途日志: 灰烬誓约终于破碎。圣匣暂时重归安宁。

JOURNEY: Malrec's broken seal points north, where a dead bastion still sings.
征途日志: 马尔雷克破碎的封印指向北方，那里有一座仍在歌唱的死寂堡垒。

JOURNEY: The Hollowbound fall. A choir reliquary answers with a stolen voice.
征途日志: 空寂守卫倒下了，唱诗圣匣中回荡着被窃取的声音。

JOURNEY: The choir seal joins your blade, and the bell crypt shudders open.
征途日志: 唱诗封印融入剑身，钟鸣地穴的大门随之震开。

JOURNEY: Vesper tolls the last bell. Every corpse in the crypt turns to listen.
征途日志: 维斯珀敲响最后的钟，地穴中的尸骸纷纷转身聆听。

JOURNEY: Vesper is silenced. The second seal remembers the sound of daylight.
征途日志: 维斯珀已沉默。第二枚封印中仍留着白昼的回响。

JOURNEY: Nyxara's soul font holds the final seal. Break the chorus at its source.
征途日志: 妮克萨拉的灵魂之泉藏着最后一枚封印。去源头终止合唱。

JOURNEY: Nyxara rises beneath a crown of voices, carrying the seal in her hollow heart.
征途日志: 妮克萨拉在万千声音的冠冕下苏醒，封印藏在她空洞的心中。

JOURNEY: The Matron's chorus fractures. Strike before the Hollow Crescendo peaks.
征途日志: 主母的合唱开始破碎。趁空寂之声达到顶峰前出击。

JOURNEY: The last voice fades. Beyond the bastion, something older answers the silence.
征途日志: 最后的歌声消逝了。堡垒之外，更古老的存在回应着沉寂。

JOURNEY: The shrine drinks blood and buys a cruel bargain from the reliquary dark.
征途日志: 神龛饮下鲜血，与圣匣深处的黑暗订下残酷契约。

JOURNEY: The obelisk answers with names of the dead. Finish the rite or feed it.
征途日志: 方尖碑低吟着死者的名字。完成仪式，否则便成为祭品。

JOURNEY: Ancient locks turn inside the vault. Greed has a voice here.
征途日志: 密库中的古老锁链缓缓转动，贪欲在此低语。

JOURNEY: An ember rift tears open, spilling hunters from Malrec's failed oaths.
征途日志: 余烬裂隙撕开大地，马尔雷克失落誓约中的猎手涌了出来。

JOURNEY: The pylon overloads your relic with ash-fire, bright enough to burn back the dark.
征途日志: 灰烬塔柱将烈火注入遗物，耀眼的光芒足以驱散黑暗。

JOURNEY: The reliquary was sealed when ash began to answer prayer.
征途日志: 当灰烬开始回应祈祷，圣匣便被封闭了。

JOURNEY: We trade names for embers and keep watch until Malrec wakes.
征途日志: 我们以名字换取余烬，守望直到马尔雷克苏醒。

JOURNEY: Blood opens the keeper's gate; only a relic blade can close it.
征途日志: 鲜血打开守护者的大门，唯有遗物之刃能够将它关闭。

JOURNEY: When the bastion bell fell silent, every buried oath began to sing.
征途日志: 堡垒的钟声沉寂之时，所有埋葬的誓约都开始歌唱。

JOURNEY: We lend Nyxara our final breath so the Hollow Choir may never end.
征途日志: 我们将最后一口气献给妮克萨拉，让空寂合唱永不终止。

JOURNEY: Malrec stole the first seal. I will drown the second in a thousand voices.
征途日志: 马尔雷克夺走了第一枚封印，我将用万千声音淹没第二枚。

Sentinel, the Reliquary is falling. Three stolen seals bind Malrec below the ash gate.
征途日志: 守卫，圣匣正走向覆灭。被夺走的三道封印，将马尔雷克束缚在灰烬之门下。

JOURNEY: I can hold the road, not the vault. Cut down the outer guard and I will mark the first cache.
征途日志: 我能守住道路，却守不住密库。除掉外围卫兵，我会为你标出第一处宝箱。

JOURNEY: The outer ward is clear. The first seal is inside that cache.
征途日志: 外围的防线已经清空。第一道封印就在那只宝箱里。

JOURNEY: Open it quickly; its lock is feeding the inner sanctum.
征途日志: 快打开它，箱上的锁正在向内殿输送力量。

JOURNEY: One seal answers the blade.
征途日志: 一道封印回应了剑刃。

JOURNEY: Good. Carry it north. Vhal will spend every acolyte he has to keep the second.
征途日志: 很好，带着它向北。为了保住第二道封印，瓦尔会让所有侍僧为他送死。

JOURNEY: The oathless blade comes at last. Kneel, and your name may yet be kept.
征途日志: 背弃誓言的剑，终于来了。跪下，你的名字或许还能被铭记。

JOURNEY: Do not answer him. Break the ambush, then break the Warden.
征途日志: 别回应他。冲破埋伏，再击倒封印守卫。

JOURNEY: No... the second seal was never yours.
征途日志: 不……第二道封印从不属于你。

JOURNEY: It is now.
征途日志: 现在属于我了。

JOURNEY: Two seals restored. The ember altar holds the last.
征途日志: 两道封印已经归位。最后一道藏在余烬祭坛里。

JOURNEY: Bring the blade closer. Every seal you reclaim opens my gate.
征途日志: 把剑带近些。你每收回一道封印，都在替我打开大门。

JOURNEY: He is baiting you. Extinguish the altar and be ready when the binding fails.
征途日志: 他在引诱你。熄灭祭坛，准备迎接束缚崩断的那一刻。

JOURNEY: Three seals, one blade, and a mortal hand. I will burn the oath from all of them.
征途日志: 三道封印、一柄剑，还有一只凡人的手。我会将它们承载的誓言烧尽。

JOURNEY: Take the reliquary boon. Break his guard and drive the seals home.
征途日志: 接下圣匣的赐福。击破他的防御，让封印重新镇住他。

JOURNEY: The vault lends me every fire you thought extinguished.
征途日志: 你以为熄灭的每一团火，都被密库借给了我。

JOURNEY: His guard is cracking. Survive the rings; punish the next break.
征途日志: 他的防御正在崩裂。避开火环，抓住下一次破防的机会。

JOURNEY: Ash remembers me...
征途日志: 灰烬会记得我……

JOURNEY: And the living will remember who ended your oath.
征途日志: 活着的人，也会记得是谁终结了你的誓言。

JOURNEY: The broken seal points north. The Hollow Road is open, and the Bastion is answering.
征途日志: 破碎的封印指向北方。空寂之路已经开启，堡垒正在回应。

JOURNEY: The Hollow Road ends here. Nyxara has woven Malrec's stolen seal into a choir of the dead.
征途日志: 空寂之路到此为止。妮克萨拉将夺自马尔雷克的封印，织进了亡者的合唱。

JOURNEY: The vanguard stands between us and the reliquary. Make them quiet enough for the ward to speak.
征途日志: 先锋军挡在我们与圣匣之间。让他们安静下来，护佑才有机会回应。

JOURNEY: The vanguard breaks. That choir reliquary carries the first counter-seal.
征途日志: 先锋军溃败了。那只唱诗圣匣里，藏着第一道反制封印。

JOURNEY: Give us your name, Sentinel. We will sing you home.
征途日志: 守卫，把你的名字交给我们。我们会唱着歌，送你归乡。

JOURNEY: The seal is cold. It is trying to speak.
征途日志: 这道封印冰冷刺骨。它想开口说话。

JOURNEY: Do not listen. Its echo has opened the bell crypt; Vesper guards the second.
征途日志: 别听。它的回声已经打开钟鸣墓穴，第二道封印由维斯珀守着。

JOURNEY: One toll for Malrec. One for Nyxara. The third is yours.
征途日志: 第一声钟鸣送给马尔雷克，第二声送给妮克萨拉。第三声，送给你。

JOURNEY: Cross the crypt before he rings it. Silence Vesper and his choir.
征途日志: 在他敲钟前穿过墓穴。让维斯珀和他的合唱团归于沉寂。

JOURNEY: The bell... still rings below...
征途日志: 钟声……仍在下面回荡……

JOURNEY: Because Nyxara's soul font is the clapper. Take his seal to it.
征途日志: 因为妮克萨拉的灵魂之泉，才是那口钟的钟舌。将他的封印带过去。

JOURNEY: Every soul you freed has come to me. Break the font, and you only give them teeth.
征途日志: 你释放的每个灵魂，都来到了我这里。砸碎泉眼，只会让它们长出獠牙。

JOURNEY: The final seal is inside that chorus. Shatter it and face what wakes.
征途日志: 最后一道封印藏在合唱之中。击碎它，直面随之苏醒的东西。

JOURNEY: Malrec wanted dominion. I want no voice to die alone.
征途日志: 马尔雷克想要统治。而我，不愿让任何声音独自消亡。

JOURNEY: Her crown carries the seal. Claim the boon, interrupt the Crescendo, and tear it free.
征途日志: 封印就在她的冠冕上。接下赐福，打断渐强咏唱，将封印夺回来。

JOURNEY: Choir, rise! Drown the blade in every final breath.
征途日志: 合唱团，起身！用所有临终的喘息，淹没那柄剑！

JOURNEY: The chorus is fractured. Break her before it reforms.
征途日志: 合唱已经破碎。趁它尚未重聚，击倒她。

JOURNEY: Silence... was never empty.
征途日志: 寂静……从来不是空无一物。

JOURNEY: No. It belongs to the living.
征途日志: 不。它属于活着的人。

JOURNEY: Both seals answer. The Bastion is quiet, and the Reliquary campaign is complete.
征途日志: 两道封印都已回应。堡垒重归安宁，圣匣远征到此结束。

JOURNEY: Blood for passage. Courage for debt.
征途日志: 以血换通途，以勇气偿债。

JOURNEY: The obelisk knows the names you buried. Feed it enemies, or join them.
征途日志: 方尖碑记得你埋葬的名字。用敌人喂饱它，否则你也会成为其中之一。

JOURNEY: Ancient locks, fresh greed. Take what helps the oath and leave before the vault chooses a keeper.
征途日志: 古老的锁，新生的贪欲。只取誓约所需之物，趁密库尚未选出守护者，赶快离开。

JOURNEY: A failed oath has torn the road open. Its hunters already know your scent.
征途日志: 一场失败的誓约撕开了道路。裂隙中的猎手，早已记住你的气息。

JOURNEY: That pylon is overloading the relic. Spend its fire now, before it spends you.
征途日志: 那座塔柱正在让圣物过载。趁它的烈焰尚未吞噬你，先将力量倾泻出去。
